name: MailTitle_Entry

name: MailTitle_Entry_Loop

name: MailTitle_CursorLeft

name: MailTitle_CursorRight
evidence: Right handler (hJoyPressedRepeat&$10 at 40C1): snd bc=$36 then falls into MailTitle_MoveCursorRight; exec monkey_camp_reg2

name: MailTitle_MoveCursorRight

name: MailTitle_DrawTextLine

name: MailTitle_CharPtr

name: MailTitle_FindLine
evidence: B=line: HL=start of line B in D500 (lines end at $0D or 12 chars, 2 bytes/char), D=$FF if the text ends earlier, E=line length; ends with [rRAMG]=0 (twin of Profile_FindLine)
